title: DaVinci MIQRO-C Portable Vaporizer
description:
The MIQRO-C is one of the world’s smallest dual use vaporizer built with Clean First Technology. Dimensions are 23 x 34 x 80mm, weighing only 87g.

Featuring removable battery, USB-C rapid charging port, and easy-to-use Smart Paths™ temperature settings, the MIQRO-C is the perfect compact vaporizer for a quick micro-dose session.

Utilizing advanced material science to select only the cleanest available components in our vaporizers. No metals or plastics are used in our sealed glass a vapor path providing our customer the highest purity.

Glass-Lined Ceramic Heating Oven
Alumina Ceramic, glass lined oven boasts +/= 1-degree temperature accuracy for optimal heating of your dry herb or concentrate. Heats in 39 seconds.

Smart Paths
Easy to use, guided experience with 4 path options. The temperature gradually increases 20 degrees over each 5 minute session.

Sealed Zirconia/Glass Vapor Path
No plastics or metals are used in our sealed zirconia/glass vapor path providing purity to the connoisseur.

Included in the box:
1x DaVinci MIQRO-C Vaporizer
1x 18350 Battery
1x Vaporizer Users Manual
1x 10mm Water Adapter
Cleaning Tools
Alcohol Wipes
USB To Type-C Cable

BONUS ITEMS: STORZ GRINDER, 2 CLEANING STICKS

Specifications
Features: Type C Charging, Smart Paths, Clean Tech.
Heating Method: Heat Not Burn Conduction Glass Lined Conduction Oven
Heat Up Time: 39 Seconds
Battery: Type 18350, 30 mins use. Removable, rechargeable.
Communication: 4 lights
Capacity: 0.3g Dry herb capacity. 0.2g with dosage pod*
Safety: Heavy Metals Tested. Rohs Certified.
Dimensions: 23 x 34 x 80mm
Weight: 87g
Warranty: 5 Years
